entities.name: Zénon Bacq
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zénon Marcel Bacq was a Belgian radiobiologist and inventor. He studied medicine at the Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB), and became an MD in 1927. He studied at Harvard University (1929–1930), with a grant from the FNRS. He taught animal physiology, pathology, as well as pharmacology and radiobiology at the University of Liège (ULg).

entities.summary: Zénon Marcel Bacq was a Belgian radiobiologist and inventor. He studied medicine at the Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB), and became an MD in 1927. He studied at Harvard University (1929–1930), with a grant from the FNRS. He taught animal physiology, pathology, as well as pharmacology and radiobiology at the University of Liège (ULg).
